title: The Physics of Woodpecker Impacts
hook: A single woodpecker impact would instantly concuss a human.
script: A single woodpecker impact would instantly concuss a human. So how does this bird survive striking wood at 20 pecks per second? Each strike decelerates its head at 1,000 times the force of gravity. Its brain is too small for damage, weighing only two paperclips. A 2022 study found its skull acts like a stiff hammer, not a cushion. To prevent its eyes from popping out, a third eyelid locks them in place. This violent headbanging is how they carve out a home.
